**Implementation note:** hf_entry_gated vol_target (Yang-Zhang realized vol). Unmeasured on the grid; V18 measured it on RSP.

## Description

Scale portfolio exposure up or down to target a chosen annualized volatility using recent realized volatility.

## Where it may fit

Portfolios with changing realized volatility where systematic exposure control is desired.

## Vehicles

Equity, futures, CTA, multi-asset and leveraged-ETF overlays.

## Required data

Portfolio returns/prices, rolling volatility, target volatility, leverage/margin limits and costs.

## Caveats

Volatility targeting may de-risk after a decline and add exposure after calm periods; it does not prevent gap losses.
